description:
As a new visitor, I want to create an account so I can place orders.

* All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it.
* An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
* Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors.
* A customer under 18 years old cannot register.
** Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.
** Password must be at least 8 characters.
** Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old."

criteria.text: All required fields filled with valid data → account created and the user can sign in with it. (Required fields: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password.)
An already-registered email → a clear error, and no duplicate account.
Invalid email format or a password below the minimum length → inline validation errors. (Password must be at least 8 characters.)
A customer under 18 years old cannot register. (Age is calculated from date of birth; under 18 → "You must be at least 18 years old.")

cases.title: Register with all required fields valid and sign in with the new account
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <first name>, <last name>, <a date of birth of an 18-year-old or older person>, <an email address not yet registered> and <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Submit the registration form.
Open the sign-in page and sign in with the email and password just used.
cases.expected: The account is created and the user can sign in with the registered email and password.

cases.title: Submit registration with a required field left empty
steps: Open the registration page.

Fill all required fields (first name, last name, date of birth, email, password) with valid data, leaving one required field empty, e.g. <the required field under test, one of: first name, last name, date of birth, email, password>.
Submit the registration form.
cases.expected: The account is not created, because an account is created only when all required fields are filled with valid data. The exact wording/placement of the message is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Register with an email that is already registered
cases.preconditions: <an email address that already belongs to a registered account> exists in the system.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter <first name>, <last name>, <a date of birth of an 18-year-old or older person>, the already-registered email address and <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Submit the registration form.
Check in the system (e.g. admin/customer list) how many accounts exist for that email address.
cases.expected: A clear error is shown (exact text not specified in the story) and no duplicate account is created - only the original account exists for that email.

cases.title: Register with an invalid email format
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter valid values for first name, last name, <a date of birth of an 18-year-old or older person> and <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Enter <a string that is not a valid email format, e.g. missing @ or domain> in the email field.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the email field and the account is not created. The exact error text is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Register with a password shorter than 8 characters
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter valid values for first name, last name, <a date of birth of an 18-year-old or older person> and the unregistered email address.
Enter a password of 7 characters in the password field.
Attempt to submit the registration form.
cases.expected: An inline validation error is shown for the password field and the account is not created. The exact error text is not specified in the story.

cases.title: Register with a password of exactly the minimum length (8 characters)
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter valid values for first name, last name, <a date of birth of an 18-year-old or older person> and the unregistered email address.
Enter a password of exactly 8 characters.
Submit the registration form.
Open the sign-in page and sign in with the email and the 8-character password.
cases.expected: No password length validation error is shown, the account is created and the user can sign in with it.

cases.title: Register with a date of birth that makes the customer under 18
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter valid values for first name, last name, the unregistered email address and <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Enter <a date of birth corresponding to an age below 18 as of today> in the date of birth field.
Submit the registration form.
cases.expected: The message "You must be at least 18 years old." is shown and the account is not created.

cases.title: Register with a date of birth of exactly 18 years ago (turns 18 today)
cases.preconditions: The registration page is reachable. <an email address that is not yet registered> is available.
steps: Open the registration page.
Enter valid values for first name, last name, the unregistered email address and <a password of at least 8 characters>.
Enter the date exactly 18 years before today as the date of birth.
Submit the registration form.
Open the sign-in page and sign in with the email and password just used.
cases.expected: The message "You must be at least 18 years old." is not shown, the account is created and the user can sign in with it.
